# Dataset attribution

The JSON case files in this directory are reproduced from the MEP Plant Room Pipe Routing Dataset under its stated CC BY 4.0 license:

- Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/IHNF/mep-plant-room-pipe-routing
- Associated paper: Zhang, F., Zhu, K., & Joneja, A. (2026). Automated multi-pipe routing in MEP plant rooms: Preference-driven multi-objective coordination framework for design prototyping. *Automation in Construction*. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.autcon.2026.107201
- Included subset: `input_case.json`, `output_layout.json`, and `output_cost.json` for the seven published cases. The optional Revit visualization files are not included.
- Changes: source JSON files are unmodified; `audit_public_plantroom_dataset.py` and its output are separate compatibility-analysis artifacts.
